title: Neon rain
suits: developer tools, AI, security, gaming, crypto, nightlife and delivery products; pitches with an edge that want energy without darkness. Not for wellness, family or finance-trust decks.

params.data-tod: 0 dusk (coral smog, signs waking) · .5 night (magenta) · 1 three in the morning (teal smog, heaviest rain)
params.--brand: on the section: the koi on the holo billboard
params.--brand-2: on the section: the billboard's panel, ring and glow, and the rain that passes in front of it
params.--field (set by the scene): the violet sky behind the headline zone, so --ink-auto stays right

details: neon signs are drawn as single-stroke glass tubes (glow, tube, white-hot core), not as type
the T in HOTEL buzzes out of step with the rest of the sign; the E and L below it shimmer in the puddle
the 24H sign blinks slowly, all three letters together, like a cheap timer
rain falls at two depths; near streaks pick up the colour of the sign they pass, far rain stays pale
rain shows bright only inside the street lamp's cone, the way it does on a real night
rain is thinner over the headline zone so the top-left stays calm
splash rings open and fade on the wet pavement; their count rises with the hour
flying cars on two sky lanes: red tail streaks going right, white heads coming left, the near lane bobbing slightly
one near-lane car is a patrol spinner with alternating red and blue lights
the holo billboard's koi swims back and forth, turning at each end; every 20 s the image tears into red and cyan slices with a scan bar for half a second
a monorail glides across the beam every 26 s with lit windows and passengers' heads
a delivery drone crosses low every 30 s with a parcel and a blinking light
aircraft warning lights on the megatowers blink each on its own beat
steam rises from a street vent and the noodle pot, tinted by whichever neon it drifts past
the noodle cook ladles, the customer on the stool bows to slurp now and then, the paper lantern sways
a cat sits on the glowing vending machine and flicks its tail every few seconds
two people under umbrellas, one of them a transparent umbrella with a glowing rim
a drop gathers under the overhead cable and falls every 4 s
towers keep one window colour each; some are lit in floor bands; pink light strips trace a few edges
puddles mirror the signs and the smog glow, rippled and broken; the rest of the pavement only shines faintly
